Your passport's price at TU Delft: €2,771 or €26,479?

In 2027/28 the statutory fee is €2,771, but non-EU/EEA students pay the institutional fee: bachelor's €20,563, master's €26,479. If you apply on a Turkish passport, the institutional (non-EU) rate usually applies.

Source: tudelft.nl (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Non-EU master's fees: same year, different universities

TU Delft: €26,479 (institutional fee, MSc)
Erasmus Rotterdam: €22,800 (RSM €28,000, medicine €37,000)
Wageningen: €22,560 (master's)
TU Eindhoven: €22,400 (master's)
Utrecht: €22,000 (one program example)
Statutory fee (EU/EEA): €2,771 (usually does not apply on a Turkish passport)

Institutional fees vary by faculty. Business and medicine may be higher. Living costs and visa requirements are separate.

Source: tudelft.nl, eur.nl, wur.nl, tue.nl, uu.nl (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

Dresden: an earlier deadline for non-EU applicants

For the winter semester, non-EU applicants with foreign diplomas apply from 1 April to 31 May. With an EU or German diploma, the deadline is 15 July. Through uni-assist, first application €75. Some master's programs have different dates. No year is stated.

Source: tu-dresden.de (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

“If you are an EU citizen, you pay home fees in the UK”

The truth: An EU passport does not get you home fees. As an EU citizen starting in 2026/27, you pay the same fee as international students unless you have UK residence status (settled/pre-settled).

Source: info.lse.ac.uk, york.ac.uk (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.

info.text:
Bachelor's applications through UCAS: one form, key dates

1. Open an account, add choices: Applications for 2027 entry opened on UCAS on 12 May 2026. You apply to more than one university with a single form.
2. Know the deadlines: Oxford, Cambridge, medicine, dentistry, veterinary closed 15 October 2026. Most programs: 13 January 2027, 18:00 (UK time).
3. If you are late: Extra (an added choice) opens on 25 February. Applications received by 30 June 2027 are forwarded, then it's Clearing.
4. Over the summer: Clearing (applying for unfilled places) opens on 2 July 2027. The deadline is 23 September 2027.

Master's applications go directly to the university, not through UCAS, and dates vary by program.

Source: ucas.com (checked November 2026). Confirm on the official page before you apply.
